parameters.content:
ZALO-01 — Intake

POST normalized Zalo messages to the private high-entropy webhook path. The path acts as a local capability secret and stays out of execution data. Messages are deduplicated before triage.

SAFETY BOUNDARY

Never auto-react, vote, approve, agree, spend money, or send casual replies. Casual/work replies are drafts only. Telegram is the primary delivery channel; until its credential exists, alerts remain in the safe outbox and execution logs. Gmail is intentionally omitted because no Gmail credential is configured.
